summary.plain: The international team of scientists, based partly at TRIUMF and partner universities, planning and building the P-ONE neutrino telescope for the deep Pacific Ocean.
summary.technical: International collaboration developing the P-ONE deep-sea neutrino telescope on Ocean Networks Canada's NEPTUNE infrastructure; no published total membership count found this session.
